verdict.rationale: Scoped API credentials are a fair question for a business banking SaaS like Relay, so the axis applies. The pack only documents role-based app access for team members and advisors, and spend limits on cards. Those are adjacent human-user and card controls, not issuable least-privilege API credentials for an agent, and nothing in the pack mentions an API or API keys.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
